titulo: Nobody Noticed This About GTA 6's Map
tema: Mapa ~3x RDR2 (según quienes lo vieron en Rockstar), Leonida es una isla, se ve muy lejos; en la sesión de El Rubius entraron a un hotel, subieron piso por piso en ascensor hasta el helipuerto sin pantallas de carga.
frases: GTA 6's map is about three times the size of Red Dead 2.
That's what people who saw it at Rockstar said.
But here's the detail nobody noticed: Leonida is an island.
And you can see really far across it.
And also: you can explore buildings floor by floor.
In Rubius's session, they walked into a hotel and took the elevator up to the roof. No loading screens.
Which part are you visiting first?
